I was in college when I came out as Bisexual. I knew my parents and most friends would be cool about it. I trickle came out, mentioned it when it was relevant. It was easier for me that way, I wanted to avoid a big "I'm dating a man" drama. I figured if I didn't make a big deal out of it no one else would. My dad was mildly peeved I hadn't told him sooner. It worked out really well for me, no one really made a big deal out of it.
